name: rea-shim
description: Unofficial personal-use one-line MCP launcher and explicit bootstrapper for rea: serves upstream rea-agents over stdio, and can install the official JDK and Ghidra the exact upstream release requires. Ships no upstream code. All credit to the original rea authors.

scripts.check: node --check bin/rea-shim.js && node --check lib/bootstrap.js && node --check lib/checks.js && node --check lib/discovery.js && node --check lib/install.js && node --check lib/sources.js && node --check lib/support.js

author: nathwn12
